5. How long we keep your data

As long as your account is active. If you want to delete your account and your data, write to our contact email and we will do it within a reasonable time, unless the law requires us to keep some record.
You can ask us to access your data, correct it, delete it, or withdraw your consent at any time, by writing to our contact email.

Your data is protected by database-level access policies (each account can only read its own information, except for authorized administrative staff) and encrypted connections (HTTPS). No platform is 100% infallible, but we actively work to keep this information safe.
If we change something important about how we handle your data, we will announce it inside the platform before it takes effect.

This document is a starting point and does not replace professional legal advice — before operating publicly with accounts of minors, review it with a lawyer familiar with the protection of minors' data in your country.

4. The pet and the AI characters

The responses of your pet and the campus characters are generated by a third party's artificial intelligence model. They can be wrong or give outdated or inaccurate information — don't treat them as a single source of truth, and consult your teacher or a trusted source for any important question.
When using features that involve other people (chat, online chess, live classes, friends), you commit to:
Treat other students and teachers with respect.
Not share offensive, illegal or inappropriate content with the rest of the community.
Not cheat or exploit system errors to improperly gain advantages (XP, coins, grades).
We may suspend or close accounts that break these rules.

The content of the courses (videos, texts, exercises) is the property of Oliver Academy or of whoever licensed it to the platform. You may use it for your personal learning; redistributing or reselling it without permission is not allowed.
We may update these terms, and we will let you know inside the platform before the change takes effect. If we ever discontinue the service, we will give reasonable advance notice.
Oliver Academy is offered "as is", especially during this alpha phase. We do our best to keep the platform working properly, but we do not guarantee it is free of errors at all times.
